description: Compact truthful ladder prescription (REQ-012; C35; R65, R70, R71, R72, R94, R95, R117; V11) delivered through the accepted shared owner src/ui/refinements/ladder.tsx (LadderPrescription: one concise line per movement with its compact equipment, whole progression or fixed companion target and prescribed load, then LadderRounds: every round as a wrapping read-only tile in the ×/· notation with the fixed companion in each) over ladderRungs and the column readings ladderProgressionText / ladderRoundReadings in src/state/ladder.ts, composed by the route consumers LadderBlock (src/ui/ladder-block.tsx; legacy, raced and scheduled ladders, the rung row drawn only once answered, the capped window's 'Move through the rounds' paragraph and the 'same every round' suffix removed) and Review's ReviewSection (src/ui/review-block.tsx; the same rounds read-only under the accepted movement rows), on the real /review and /workout routes (JOURNEY-012) with three differently shaped ladders from their own data, and the accepted gallery states /gallery/refinements?state=ladder-4 and ?state=ladder-12 (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d). Read-only presentation: no storage key, field or writer. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-012 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/ladder-rungs.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false

cases.name: TASK-012 compact truthful ladder prescription > AC-C35-01 the accepted twelve-round ladder on /workout states its concise progression once, then every round’s push up and fixed burpee as a compact tile after its Start — with no rung row repeating it

TASK-012 compact truthful ladder prescription > AC-R012-01 every name, sequence, load and unit, round count and cap is read from each ladder’s own data — a loaded descending ladder with a distance companion and a scheduled pyramid with no cap — never from the accepted screenshot

TASK-012 compact truthful ladder prescription > AC-R012-02 no “same every round” suffix, no “Move through the rounds” paragraph and no “reps” between a quantity and its movement: the ×/· notation keeps the order, every target and each movement’s identity, the fixed companion in every round

TASK-012 compact truthful ladder prescription > JOURNEY-012 recovery: Start, Pause and the cap keep the prescription unchanged; the rung question and the reached reading appear only once answered; nothing is recorded but the declared answer

TASK-012 compact truthful ladder prescription > JOURNEY-012 a scheduled ladder’s tiles keep each start and mark the live round from its own clock through Start, a close and reopen and the end of the schedule

TASK-012 compact truthful ladder prescription > JOURNEY-012 a ladder with no explicit timing, an inverse pair and a malformed ladder are stated through the same owner: their rounds are their rungs, and absent rungs keep their existing meaning

TASK-012 compact truthful ladder prescription > JOURNEY-012 the readings come from the columns: rising, falling, uneven, timed, distance, per-side and inverse ladders, and the round count the timing gives

TASK-012 compact truthful ladder prescription > JOURNEY-012 gallery ladder-4 and ladder-12 draw the actual consumer’s compact prescription, from the gallery’s own data, with no network and no route storage
